logp.method_description: The lipophilicity of the gallium complexes was determined as the octanol/PBS distribution coefficient at pH 7.4 (LogD7.4) using a shake-flask procedure. PBS (pH 7.4) and n-octanol were mutually pre-saturated by shaking at 180 rpm and 37 °C overnight to generate octanol-saturated PBS (OSP) and PBS-saturated octanol (PSO). Calibration curves were obtained by recording the UV–vis absorbance of a series of solutions (0–32 μg mL-1) prepared in OSP or PSO. For partitioning, 2 mg of each gallium complex was added to a mixture of PBS (5 mL) and octanol (5 mL), shaken at 180 rpm and 37 °C for 12 h, then centrifuged to ensure phase separation. The absorbance of the compounds in the octanol and PBS layers was measured and converted to concentration using the corresponding standard curves and calculation. LogD7.4 = log10(Coctanol / CPBS)
